patterns: APPSC asks the climate type of AP in one word (Tropical / tropical monsoon, Koeppen Aw).
AP extremes are the recurring facts: wettest Sileru-Sabari valleys, driest Hagari valley/Anantapur, Rayalaseema rain-shadow with NE-monsoon peak.
Other PSCs ask world-level classification (share of arid/semi-arid lands), Koeppen/Trewartha/Thornthwaite basics.
App adds many 2024-26 climate-change statistics and SAPCC measures that the PYQs do not test.
